description: Drop a part by opaque part_id (a path or name is unknown_part). scope assembly removes the row and does not commit. scope repo, after confirm: true, deletes parts/<id>.js in one commit and returns the assemblies that use the part. A failed scan is delete_refused and writes nothing. Other assemblies are not rewritten. Takes return: "status" | "summary" | "full" (MCP default "status": status.script is omitted; "summary" adds status.features; "full" echoes the script).

confirm.description: Required true when scope is repo.

part_id.description: Part id from parts. Not a vault path.

return.description: How much of status to return: "status" drops status.script, "summary" drops it and adds status.features (the feature strip), "full" keeps the whole script. Over MCP the default is "status"; in the page it is "full". Read the script with get_script.

scope.description: assembly drops the row; repo deletes parts/<id>.js in one commit and returns the assemblies that use the part.

name: delete_part
